info.name: LIV-118 API-120 Staff Decision
info.description: Run all folders through scripts/test_api120_s01_integration.py --newman. Direct real S01/S04 HTTP with disposable PostgreSQL/Redis and CONTROLLED SQL VERIFIED-grant fixtures. The runner owns role/tenant/secret/outage phase changes and DB readback; running all folders without those phase changes is invalid. No real S02 adapter: PASS with valid evidence asserts fail-closed 503, not successful business PASS. Positive PASS remains component-test coverage with a test source provider. No production grant lifecycle, Gateway or full Golden Flow claim. Credentials/environment/raw reports remain temporary and must not be committed.

exec: pm.test('S01 issues actual User JWT', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const t=pm.response.json().data.accessToken; pm.expect(t.split('.')).to.have.length(3); pm.environment.set('accessToken',t); });

item.name: Load effective Staff scope from S01

exec: pm.test('Effective Staff permission and repository grant', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.identityId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('actorId')); pm.expect(d.workspaceGrants.some(g => g.roles.includes('STAFF') && g.permissions.includes('DOCUMENT_STAFF_REVIEW') && g.repositoryIds.includes(pm.environment.get('repositoryId')))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: RETURN persists Draft after real fresh authorization

exec: pm.test('Typed receipt and Draft transition', () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['code','data','message']); pm.expect(b.message).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.data.versionId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('reviewVersionId')); pm.expect(b.data.state).to.eql('DRAFT'); pm.expect(b.data.reviewStage).to.eql(null); pm.expect(b.data.revision).to.eql(1); pm.variables.set('returnBody',pm.response.text()); pm.variables.set('returnEtag',pm.response.headers.get('ETag')); });

item.name: Exact replay preserves original receipt after fresh ALLOW
